definitions.full: H4695. matstsuth [ מַצּוּת ] noun feminine id.; — only suffix מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ אַנְשֵׁי Isa 41:12 i.e. the men who strove with thee (|| מִלְהַמְתֶּ֑ךָ אַנְשֵׁי ).
